visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a professional black button-down shirt, stands centrally against a turquoise gradient background featuring a large, stylized mascot head with wide eyes. He holds a pen and a small remote, using active hand gestures and expressive facial movements to address the viewer directly. (2) The scene cuts to a screenshot of an academic journal article titled 'Earliest evidence of smoke-dried mummification' from PNAS, highlighting authors and publication details. The man's upper body remains visible at the bottom of the frame as he continues to present the information. (3) The visual shifts to display a series of archaeological photographs and 3D digital models of ancient human skeletal remains. The skeletons are shown tightly curled in fetal positions with anatomical labels like 'rt. patella' and 'rt. humerus' superimposed on the green-tinted 3D reconstructions. (4) A scientific graph titled 'FTIR Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy' appears, showing several colorful spectral curves representing different archaeological sites such as 'Gaoman, China' and 'Huyanhua, China.' The man points toward the data while explaining the chemical analysis results. (5) An educational illustration is presented, depicting a prehistoric scene where figures are shown in various stages of a ritual or process. One figure is suspended over a smoky fire on a wooden rack, while others are shown being tied into bundles or sitting nearby, labeled with letters A through D.
